opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based established independent researchers holding a permanent or fixed‑term position at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation; must lead interdisciplinary collaboration across Academies.
opportunities.summary: Supports interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research across the humanities, social sciences, engineering and natural sciences, with awards up to £200,000 for up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher at any career stage, able to partner with a gallery, archive, library, museum or performing‑arts organisation.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public‑engagement projects in the humanities and social sciences, up to £8,000 for projects running between April 2027 and Dec 2028.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or recognised research organisation, with a doctorate awarded between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027 and not holding a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships for early‑career researchers to undertake independent research in the humanities or social sciences; funded at 80 % of salary costs under FEC.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or independent research organisation, working in the humanities or social sciences; open to early‑career, mid‑career and senior researchers.
opportunities.summary: Supports skill‑development and methodological innovation in quantitative, digital, language and interdisciplinary research, with awards of up to £10,000 for 6–12 months.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in the humanities or social sciences, with overseas co‑applicants; must hold an established role at a UK university or research institute and allocate at least 20 % FTE to the award.
opportunities.summary: Funding for genuinely interdisciplinary projects on mobilities, involving SHAPE and STEM disciplines, up to £300,000 (80 % FEC) for two years starting March/April 2027.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences; fellowship based at DGAP in Berlin.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships (up to £150,000) to develop policy‑relevant research and networks in areas such as security, Indo‑European relations, technology & AI, and European strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027 (Alexander von Humboldt Foundation)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers affiliated with UK or German research institutions, working in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Calls for 15 UK and 15 German early‑career scholars to attend a three‑day interdisciplinary symposium on ‘Humans and Nature’; seed funding provided for collaborative projects arising from the event.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months; must meet eligibility for the target award.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £4,000 to support specific additional needs (e.g., equipment, caring costs, assistance with application) for award‑holders or prospective applicants.
